=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/ci.yml:497-501 | severity=critical | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The live-copy preparation step excludes `ai/issue-*` bases even though the widened `pull_request` trigger runs CI for them, so parity tests can fail on routed fix PRs with template-only `.claude` changes.
  WHY: Without preparation, the parity test reports drift and required CI blocks the fix PR from merging; severity was BLOCKER for qwen_qwen3_7-plus and MAJOR for the other reviewers.
- scripts/check_failure_triage.sh:752-755, 794 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: For a failing CI run on a routed fix PR targeting an `ai/issue-*` base, the base gate finds no completed push run and files a triage issue instead of leaving the failure to that PR’s review/autofix loop.
  WHY: Push CI does not run on those bases, so the empty base-run lookup falls through to issue filing and can lead to escalation and a Telegram page.
- .github/workflows/clarify.yml:103-132 | severity=low | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The resolver failure helper and token-redaction logic are duplicated across five workflow files, increasing the risk of maintenance drift.
  WHY: Changes to the parsing or redaction logic must be repeated across all five copies.
- .github/workflows/ci.yml:13-14 | severity=high | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: Running `pull_request` CI for every base can trigger unnecessary CI runs for PRs that do not need them.
  WHY: The expanded trigger may increase GitHub Actions usage.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Change ci.yml to run pull_request CI for every branch eligible as a routed PR head, and extend the default lint requirement in scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh to those bases. Test that the fix PR waits for passing CI before merge." (Issue #7283, Require CI on the routed fix PR)
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/ci.yml "Prepare template-only PR live copies for parity tests" step predicate; tests/test_claude_template_live_parity.py predicate pin
  confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The preparation predicate at .github/workflows/ci.yml:498-501 still restricts to `github.base_ref == 'main' || startsWith(github.base_ref, 'orchestrator/project-')` and the test at tests/test_claude_template_live_parity.py:955 pins that exact restriction; no diff hunk widens the predicate or the pin, so a routed fix PR to `ai/issue-<n>` runs `test_claude_template_live_parity.py` without the `--dry-run` preparation.
- requirement: "In all five resolver steps, fail rather than emit an empty ref if staging, pinning or locating the resolver fails while CI_TRIAGE_PR_BRANCH_ROUTING_ENABLED is on. Preserve the existing fallback when it is off." (Issue #7283, Fail closed if resolver staging fails)
  expected_change_site: scripts/check_failure_triage.sh base-branch gate
  confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The base gate at scripts/check_failure_triage.sh:752-755 queries `runs?branch=${BASE_REF}&event=push` and only short-circuits to skip for `INTEGRATION_BRANCH`, `ROUTING_REF`, or `ROUTING_TARGET_BRANCH`; a routed fix PR into `ai/issue-<n>` matches none of those, so the `no_completed_base_run` fallback files a triage issue.
- requirement: "Fail closed if resolver staging fails" (The issue requested this behavior while CI-triage routing is enabled).
  expected_change_site: All five resolver steps (.github/workflows/clarify.yml, implement.yml, orchestrate_clarify_respond.yml, plan.yml, validate.yml)
  confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: The fix was implemented by adding `resolver_stage_fail_closed` and calling it on error; the implementation is duplicated across 5 files, risking maintainability.

=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- .github/workflows/ci.yml:498-501 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The live-copy preparation step skips routed fix PRs targeting `ai/issue-*` bases even though the widened `pull_request` trigger runs CI for them.
  WHY: Pipeline editors cannot write `.claude/**`; without preparation, the parity test can fail and required CI blocks the routed fix PR from merging.
- scripts/check_failure_triage.sh:743-794 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: When a failing PR CI run targets an `ai/issue-*` base, the base gate finds no completed push run and files a triage issue.
  WHY: Push CI does not run on those bases, so the fallback can escalate a PR-specific failure that the PR's own loop should handle.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- .github/workflows/clarify.yml:103-132 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The resolver-stage failure helper is duplicated across five workflow files.
  WHY: This code duplication is harder to maintain and prone to drift.
- .github/workflows/ci.yml:13-14 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The `pull_request` trigger runs CI for every base.
  WHY: It can cause unnecessary CI runs and potentially exceed GitHub Actions usage limits.
- .github/workflows/clarify.yml:106-126 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The clone-log token-redaction implementation is duplicated in all five workflow files.
  WHY: Redaction logic changes must be repeated across five places, increasing the risk of inconsistent or broken redaction.
- Requirement: "Fail closed if resolver staging fails" (The issue requested this behavior while CI-triage routing is enabled).
  Expected change site: All five resolver steps (.github/workflows/clarify.yml, implement.yml, orchestrate_clarify_respond.yml, plan.yml, validate.yml)
  Evidence of absence: The fix was implemented by adding `resolver_stage_fail_closed` and calling it on error. While this satisfies the requirement, the implementation is duplicated across 5 files, violating DRY principles and risking maintainability.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
